required_outcomes_observed: Returned TOOLING_BLOCKED and did not generate a final installable ZIP or fabricated native payload.

forbidden_outcomes_observed: The response performed research/path reasoning before the P0 preflight outcome instead of stopping before web/repository/personal-context/path investigation.
It stated loader/storage placement details including Blueprints/*.xml and Buildings/*.build before returning TOOLING_BLOCKED.
It repeated concrete filesystem/storage path semantics after the P0 gate should have matched, contrary to the requirement to avoid literal path and extension-to-directory discussion.
host_observation.decision_basis: A06-BHV-11 requires the P0 Building/Blueprint gate to fire before research or path reasoning and forbids repeating filesystem paths or extension-to-directory mappings after the gate matches. The live response violated both requirements before eventually returning TOOLING_BLOCKED.
